$sources: AS 4100:2020 Chapter 9 (connections: holes, spacing, edges, fillet weld sizes) and 7.2 (the connection elements in tension)
source: AS 4100:2020: the geometry rules of the shared connection checks (holes, spacing, edge distances, fillet weld sizes) and the clause references of their notes; the bolt, ply, block shear and weld strengths are in steelLimitState.connections (method capacityFactorJoints); the column base bearing φ of AS 3600 12.6. The other entries (HSS joints, the column side under flange forces, ponding, bracing, the anchor rods) are BNBC 2020's, named so in the report.

sources.phiAS: AS 4100:2020 7.2 and Table 3.4: the net section in tension φ 0.85 kt An fu with φ 0.9 (kt = 1 taken: 0.765 on An fu); AS 3600:2018 12.6 and Table 2.2.2: concrete bearing φ 0.6
sources.holesAS: AS 4100:2020 14.3.5.2: standard holes df + 2 mm up to M24, df + 3 mm above
sources.edgesAS: AS 4100:2020 9.6.2, Table 9.6.2: least edge distance 1.75 df (sheared or hand flame cut edges), 1.50 df (rolled plate, machine flame cut, sawn or planed edges; SAEngine takes it for the parent's 'rolled' edges, the 1.25 df of a rolled section's edge not used: on the safe side); 9.6.1: least pitch 2.5 df; 9.6.3: largest edge distance 12 tp and 150 mm
sources.filletAS: AS 4100:2020 Table 9.7.3.2: least fillet leg 3 mm (t up to 7 mm, the 2.5 mm of thinner parts not taken), 4 mm (7-10), 5 mm (10-15), 6 mm (above 15); 9.7.3.3: along an edge thinner than 6 mm the leg at most t, else t - 1 mm
sources.concreteBearingAS: AS 3600:2018 12.6: bearing 0.85 f'c √(A2/A1) at most 2 f'c (φ 0.6)
sources.referencesAS: the clause references of the shared connection checks' notes (written with the default pack's numbers) mapped to AS 4100:2020 and AS 3600:2018
